title: Four Cakes by Half Past Two  (Cuatro pasteles para las dos y media)

segments.t: Diez segundos después, en la cálida cocina del café, Tessa y Owen pelan almendras con calma cuando Hannah irrumpe por la puerta batiente levantando tres dedos. Escuchemos primero la escena.
Emergency bulletin from the station desk: our mapmaker arrives at three sharp today!
Three in the afternoon?! Owen, turn both ovens up to baking heat this second!
Both switches on! How fast can four berry almond cakes bake AND cool, Tessa?
Forty minutes in the oven, thirty minutes to cool, ten minutes for warm honey glaze!
That brings us to twenty-five past two — with thirty-five minutes to spare!
I will grease all four round tins with butter while you whisk the eggs, Tessa!
Hannah, rinse those four bowls of fresh summer berries and pat them dry with linen!
Rinsing fast and gentle! Thank goodness we tested all three glazes on Sunday!
Imagine serving Batch One brass polish or Batch Two roof tiles at three today!
Less joking and faster whisking, Owen — fold the ground almonds in smoothly!
Wait — hear Graham calling my name from the lobby? Something happened with the room keys!
Go save the front desk, Hannah; Owen and I own this kitchen until half past two!
Repasemos ahora, línea por línea, esta carrera contrarreloj en la cocina.
Emergency bulletin from the station desk: our mapmaker arrives at three sharp today!
'Boletín de emergencia desde el mostrador de la estación: ¡nuestro cartógrafo llega hoy a las tres en punto!'
Three in the afternoon?! Owen, turn both ovens up to baking heat this second!
'¿¡A las tres de la tarde!? Owen, ¡sube los dos hornos a temperatura de horneado ahora mismo!'
Both switches on! How fast can four berry almond cakes bake AND cool, Tessa?
'¡Los dos interruptores encendidos! ¿Qué tan rápido pueden hornearse Y enfriarse cuatro pasteles de bayas y almendras, Tessa?'
Forty minutes in the oven, thirty minutes to cool, ten minutes for warm honey glaze!
'¡Cuarenta minutos en el horno, treinta para enfriar y diez para el glaseado tibio de miel!'
That brings us to twenty-five past two — with thirty-five minutes to spare!
'Eso nos deja en las dos y veinticinco, ¡con treinta y cinco minutos de margen!'
I will grease all four round tins with butter while you whisk the eggs, Tessa!
'¡Yo engraso con mantequilla los cuatro moldes redondos mientras tú bates los huevos, Tessa!'
Hannah, rinse those four bowls of fresh summer berries and pat them dry with linen!
'Hannah, enjuaga esos cuatro tazones de bayas frescas de verano y sécalas con toquecitos con un paño de lino.'
Rinsing fast and gentle! Thank goodness we tested all three glazes on Sunday!
'¡Enjuagando rápido y con cuidado! ¡Menos mal que probamos los tres glaseados el domingo!'
Imagine serving Batch One brass polish or Batch Two roof tiles at three today!
'¡Imaginen servir a las tres de hoy la Tanda Uno con sabor a pulimento de latón o la Tanda Dos dura como tejas!'
Less joking and faster whisking, Owen — fold the ground almonds in smoothly!
'Menos bromas y a batir más rápido, Owen: ¡incorpora suavemente las almendras molidas!'
Wait — hear Graham calling my name from the lobby? Something happened with the room keys!
'Un momento: ¿oyen a Graham llamándome desde el vestíbulo? ¡Algo pasó con las llaves de las habitaciones!'
Go save the front desk, Hannah; Owen and I own this kitchen until half past two!
'Ve a salvar la recepción, Hannah; ¡Owen y yo nos encargamos de esta cocina hasta las dos y media!'
Y ahora, toda la escena otra vez de corrido.
Emergency bulletin from the station desk: our mapmaker arrives at three sharp today!
Three in the afternoon?! Owen, turn both ovens up to baking heat this second!
Both switches on! How fast can four berry almond cakes bake AND cool, Tessa?
Forty minutes in the oven, thirty minutes to cool, ten minutes for warm honey glaze!
That brings us to twenty-five past two — with thirty-five minutes to spare!
I will grease all four round tins with butter while you whisk the eggs, Tessa!
Hannah, rinse those four bowls of fresh summer berries and pat them dry with linen!
Rinsing fast and gentle! Thank goodness we tested all three glazes on Sunday!
Imagine serving Batch One brass polish or Batch Two roof tiles at three today!
Less joking and faster whisking, Owen — fold the ground almonds in smoothly!
Wait — hear Graham calling my name from the lobby? Something happened with the room keys!
Go save the front desk, Hannah; Owen and I own this kitchen until half past two!
Los dos hornos rugen en las manos expertas de Tessa y Owen mientras Hannah vuelve corriendo a resolver un misterio de llaves en la recepción. Nos vemos en la próxima escena.
See you soon!
